issue.title: Per-bead CARGO_TARGET_DIR dirs are never cleaned up; filled /mnt/poseidon and broke stitch hooks and installs
issue.description: Found by the sase-y5 land agent: /mnt/poseidon (229G) was 100% full, ~197G of it stale per-bead cargo target dirs (sase-y5-2, sase-y5-7, sase27, plus debug/maturin/tmp) under /mnt/poseidon/cargo-target. Agents export per-bead CARGO_TARGET_DIR overrides to dodge shared-target lock contention (see sase-yn, sase-xw), but nothing ever garbage-collects the dirs after the bead closes. A live agent (sase-yh4) is now growing /home/bryan/tmp/sase/sase-yh4-cargo-target the same way. The land agent manually deleted the stale dirs to unblock (198G freed); recurrence is guaranteed without a GC or bounded-cache policy.

task_type_fields.impact: Broke the sase-y5.10 before-commit hook so a verified phase landing was stranded (mechanism tracked by sase-yo), and initially blocked just install/check for the sase-y5 land agent. Any Rust rebuild on this machine fails once the disk fills.
task_type_fields.location: agent guidance/tooling that sets per-bead CARGO_TARGET_DIR overrides (per-bead dirs under the global cargo target root and under /home/bryan/tmp/sase); no cleanup exists in the sase repo, Justfile, chops, or sase-core guidance
task_type_fields.repro: df -h /mnt/poseidon -> 100% full; just install or the just fix before-commit hook then fails with: failed to create directory /mnt/poseidon/cargo-target/release/.fingerprint/...: No space left on device (os error 28)

payload.description: the disk exhaustion this task prevents is what triggered the stranded-landing mechanism sase-yo tracks
per-bead target-dir redirection workaround whose side effects sase-yn tracks
shared cargo target correctness issue that motivated per-bead redirection
